en: A black-and-white vertical postcard view of a narrow, slightly curving cobblestone street between tall, old masonry buildings. The right side is dominated by a high façade with large sash windows and a small sloping canopy over a doorway, under which several dark‑clad figures stand. Another person walks alone farther down the street. In the distance, over the rooftops with steep gables and tiled roofs, a tall, slender church spire rises. The ground appears wet or lightly snowy, suggesting a cold season. The overall feel is of an early‑20th‑century European old town street.
